policy.design_status_meaning: The geometry and interface are selected and represented in the design.
policy.purchase_status_meaning: The exact supplier line or complete manufacturing handoff is ready.
policy.cart_ready_scope: Cart-ready identifies an exact supplier SKU and pack that can be put in the supplier cart. It does not assert a current price, fulfillment, order authorization, checkout success, installation approval, or motion authorization; unverified commercial terms must be rechecked at checkout.
policy.rfq_ready_scope: RFQ-ready means the hash-bound geometry, drawing, quote questions, receiving inspection, and qualification contract are complete and may be sent to a supplier. It does not assert supplier acceptance, quote receipt, order authorization, received-part acceptance, production use, or motion authorization.
policy.motion_authorization: Cart-ready sourcing is not permission to wind. Legacy cad/assembly.step, out/links, raw clearance and raw wirepath artifacts are controller-baseline evidence only. A physical job must use conservative measured wire and installed-liner maxima, regenerate the selected integrated candidate, pass the exact two-turn raw-cycle gate, the full-cycle flexible-conductor authority, every required launch-corner certificate, and all physical qualification gates.

items.description: Selected Leadshine CS-D508 closed-loop M2 driver; hardware order-ready, production current configuration remains a commissioning gate

cost.basis: Leadshine official online special price for the conditional candidate

evidence.observed: Manual revision 1.0 explicitly lists CS-M21708 as tested compatible, allows 20-50 VDC and 0.5-8.0 A peak, and identifies 36 V compatible supply candidates.
Current official page is Add-to-Cart at 199 USD and specifies 20-50 VDC, 0.5-8.0 A software-configured peak current in 0.1 A increments, and 1000-line encoder compatibility.
ProTuner parameter PR 2 is peak current in 0.1 A units; CS-D508 supports values 10-80, so the exact 2.5 A RMS curve equivalent of 3.5355 A peak lies between settings 3.5 A and 3.6 A.

The current Leadshine stepper catalog lists CS-M21708 at 2.5 A rated current and labels its 36/24 V speed-torque curve RMS 2.5 A, resolving the intended curve condition despite the separate product-page table typo.

Current exact active-sector authority requires 0.2357279818203625 N m and a 0.471455963640725 N m 2x threshold at M2; the official 36 V lower-edge curve is 0.735 N m (3.1180006477x), while configured-current and hot-dyno gates remain false.

commissioning_gate.required: Leadshine-confirmed CS-D508 PR 2 setting reproducing the official 36 V / RMS 2.5 A CS-M21708 curve, or a hot 36 V 300 RPM output dyno result at or above the current integrated 0.471455963640725 N m 2x threshold
commissioning_gate.observed: The exact hardware is compatible and cart-ready, but PR 2 accepts only 0.1 A peak increments: 3.5 A is 2.4749 A RMS and 3.6 A is 2.5456 A RMS, bracketing rather than exactly reproducing the 2.5 A RMS curve.

items.note: Exact driver hardware is selected and order-ready. The unresolved PR 2 choice and hot 36 V / 300 RPM dyno are post-purchase commissioning gates before energized production motion, not prerequisites for purchasing the driver needed to perform that proof. CS1-D503S is limited to 3.0 A peak and cannot bind the saved RMS 2.5 A curve; CL42T-V41 and any 24 V M2 release condition remain rejected.
